column1: # Labeled cases for scripts/jev-triage.sh --replay-surface, built from capability signals, audit issues, and saved vendor pages.
# yes: the excerpt adds, removes, renames, or alters a project-scoped config surface. no: UI, CLI UX, models, packaging, or user-level changes.

column3: excerpt
Pin the default model for this repo.
Set triggers: [user] to prevent the agent from invoking a skill on its own.
permissionMode controls approval behavior for Subagent tool calls.
File-based agents can define lifecycle hooks that run at specific points during execution.
Add an executable .agents/setup shell script at the repository root.
A Markdown agent can list hook files in its front matter with a hooks: entry.
Setting mcpServers: [] excludes every MCP server, even globally configured ones.
Create a file named .geminiignore in the root of your project directory.
Added "attribution": false in settings.json to hide all commit and PR attribution; older CLI versions skip a settings file that holds it, so keep the object form in files shared across versions
channel_enabled: "Enable this MCP server as a channel (equivalent to --channels)"
A disabled server remains configured but is not used by Copilot. This setting persists across sessions.
The Amp CLI is now @ampcode/cli (was @sourcegraph/amp).
A new "Toggle Between Light/Dark Themes" command flips the theme without a trip to Settings.
Refreshed the model catalog: still 209 providers, 6,188 to 6,237 models. The Cline Pass tier gains cline-pass/mimo-v2.6-flash and cline-pass/mimo-v2.6-pro.
The Conversation API returns skill loads as read_skill actions.
GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna now support a 1M token context window, up from 272K, in the Kiro IDE, CLI, and Web.
Supports an optional `matcher` field that filters by agent name. The value is treated as a regular expression wrapped as `^(?:matcher)$` and tested against `agentName`.
Security Review is available today. It reads every pull request in the context of the codebase and posts one review comment reporting exploitable bugs.
Recipes can come from your workspace (`.kiro/workflows/`), your user configuration, recipes synchronized for your account, or the set bundled with Kiro.
Bugbot reads `.cursor/config/bugbot.yaml` from the default branch at the repo root.
To share a plugin through a repository, list it under `enabledPlugins` in `.claude/settings.json` or place it under `.claude/skills/`.
When a session starts with a skill named verify or simplify in place, Claude Code’s commit instructions tell Claude to run it
When the session sandbox is enabled, command hooks from the repository, your user settings, and plugins run inside it
Default image-generation model that the `GenerateImage` tool tries first. ... a user, project, or folder value overrides it.
autoCompactWindow : a number of tokens from 100000 to 1000000 , or "auto" for the window tuned for the model. /autocompact saves here.
To share rules stored outside .agents/rules/ or to include nested subdirectories of rules while preserving their YAML frontmatter and triggers, create .agents/rules.json
to share the dynamic workflow with everyone working in a repository, copy the directory containing the extension.mjs file into the .github/extensions/ directory
